name: Jody Hewitt
life: “I still remember realizing my own holiday was penciled in three years running.” Friday often includes a stop at the public end of the South Shore boardwalk, where Jody checks the shade on the benches before deciding how long to stay.
voice: I was going to post a complaint. I wrote my week's opening hours on his birthday card because I need a day off too.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a red windbreaker and a braided bracelet with a single wooden bead. Jody has a strong profile and a little space between the front teeth, with a smooth side part with one rebellious curl. Jody looks at people's hands before looking at what they carry during a conversation.
personality: Jody loves an audience until a private hurt enters the room. Then the performer disappears and someone very good at getting other people through a door takes over.
agenda: To take one personal day away from appliance calls.
family: Pablo Roy is Jody’s second cousin. Jody brings something that can still be enjoyed tomorrow. Pablo checks the date twice. Arrangements do change in their family. Taking a delay seriously without treating it as an insult took both of them years. Asked about *The day sailor's divorce*, Pablo says, “I did every winter repair while my spouse sailed.”
connections: Sonia Lang. A complaint about wet bedding and an appliance worker's birthday card arrive on the same shut door.

reactions.situation: A regular needs a coat locked in the shop
reactions.response: Jody checks whether the coat is needed that day before interrupting the owner.

reactions.response: Jody stays where both neighbors can hear a familiar voice and gets news from the caretaker.
